meta.name: The Office
meta.description: Life at Wilkins Chawla, a mediocre paper company is as boring as the humour of its 'Fun'jabi boss. Add to it some ordinary employees, an uncomfortable receptionist, the boss' sycophant, and the mediocrity goes a notch higher!

videos.title: Welcome to Wilkins Chawla
videos.overview: Riya breaks the dreaded news of the probable downsizing at Wilkins Chawla to Chaddha, the 'Chief Fun Officer', and asks him to keep it under wraps. And then, the leak happens.

videos.title: P.O.S.H.
videos.overview: Madhukar is asked to conduct a sexual harassment workshop at the office. Obviously, Chaddha doesn't have a great opinion about the workshop and the new policy.

videos.title: Appraisal Time
videos.overview: It's appraisal time at Wilkins Chawla, but Chaddha is losing sleep over his "relationship" with Riya. Meanwhile, a new client relations executive has joined the team.

videos.title: The Nosy Boss
videos.overview: When Chaddha begins to monitor the team's emails, he doesn't like what he finds. Elsewhere, Pammi suspects romance brewing between an unlikely pair in the office.

videos.title: Diwali Dhamaka
videos.overview: Diwali celebration at Wilkins Chawla is in full swing and Chaddha suggests the team to play a weird game. Result? Boom.

videos.title: The Hunter
videos.overview: Chaddha takes the team to Jim Corbett National Park for a motivational session where a series of events make Amit realise that he can't let Pammi go.

videos.title: The Accident
videos.overview: When Chaddha burns his foot at home, TP volunteers to help, but lands in trouble. However, we see a new side of TP's personality.

videos.title: It's a Secret
videos.overview: Now that Chaddha knows Amit's secret, the latter is on tenterhooks. Meanwhile, a suspicious TP spies on Rinchin and a truth is revealed.

videos.title: The Hooligan
videos.overview: Someone has vandalised Chaddha's office and he suspects the employees of foul play. Who's the culprit?

videos.title: Riya Vs Chaddha
videos.overview: Riya is at the Faridabad branch to lead a seminar for the women. Feeling ignored, Chaddha tries to bond with the menfolk in the office and the warehouse.

videos.title: Hearts and Roses
videos.overview: Chaddha is off to meet the new CFO of Wilkins Chawla on Valentine's Day. During the trip, he spills the beans about Riya and him to other branch managers, one of whom uses the information to his advantage.

videos.title: Top Salesman
videos.overview: Being the top salesman of the year at Wilkins Chawla, TP has to address the salesmen's convention. Finding him nervous, Amit offers to help.

videos.title: Welcome, Kids!
videos.overview: It's kids' day and the employees get their children to work. Chaddha, of course, has a gala time. Amid the fun, Saleem's teenage daughter develops a crush on Sapan and Kitty runs interference.

videos.title: Chaddha's Birthday
videos.overview: Chaddha is excited about his birthday but the staff isn't. They are worried about Kutty's impending medical test reports.

videos.title: 'Joint' Effort
videos.overview: TP finds a leftover joint in the parking lot, and tries to find the owner. When no one confesses, he schedules a drug test for all. Worried, Chaddha puts forth a weird demand to TP.

videos.title: Employee Grievances
videos.overview: Chaddha learns that employee conflicts that are registered with Madhukar have not been resolved. He takes the matter in his own hands and creates a mess.

videos.title: Founder's Day
videos.overview: Chaddha organises a Founder's Day party for charity, but inadvertently ends up inviting both Riya and Geeta. Post party, Amit opens up to Pammi.
